ANC-013.sentence: The wrap circuit SHALL pin the anchor read key (lane 6) and the chunk write key (lane 15) to the key constant 15.

ANC-014.sentence: When the SherlockLedger contract is deployed, the SherlockLedger contract SHALL store `C_P` in top-level slot 15.

ANC-015.sentence: If a contract's ledger layout uses top-level index 15, then the Mycroft compiler SHALL refuse the contract before deploy and name the colliding field.

ANC-016.sentence: If an ordinary call (mode 0) carries the anchor-write template in lanes 11 to 19 and 21, then the wrap circuit SHALL refuse the witness.

ANC-017.sentence: When a chunk call reads or writes a lock, the `L_Fr` circuit SHALL compute the lock operand `x_j` of ANC-002 from the run's `c`, `run_tag`, `k`, `d_in`, `d_out`, the FP-3 link `pack(C_(j+1))` and `j`.

ANC-018.sentence: The `L` circuit SHALL bind every effect lane of the call vector to the guest effect word that the run wrote at that lane.

ANC-019.sentence: When a run is cut into `k` chunks, the `L` circuit SHALL bind `k` to the slice count of the run through the forward claim chain.

LW-020.sentence: The `L_Fr` circuit SHALL carry the type element `TY_BB` = 0 or `TY_FR` = 1 as the sixth element of every MEM_BUS message.

LW-021.sentence: If a tape has an ill-typed operand, then the `L_Fr` host SHALL refuse the tape in `Machine::new`.

LW-022.sentence: If a verifying-key WHIR shape has `log_rs < k`, then the wrap host SHALL refuse the shape before it synthesizes a cell.

LPC-001.sentence: When row T8b closes, the tested-design loop SHALL record I-13 and the four GP hook rows as FROZEN with real-proof evidence or as FREEZE-PENDING with a measured reason.

LPC-002.sentence: When the STACKS AIR and VALUE DIGEST land in the inline kernel, the MERGE-WORK key SHALL have at most 5,400 columns.

LPC-003.sentence: When row T8c runs, the tested-design loop SHALL build the X8 in-circuit Compact verifier and the `L` check over a SET root on real proofs.

LPC-004.sentence: When a circuit change lands after openvm c4bd312, the tested-design loop SHALL run a Carbon Quint lane on it and file a lead verdict.

LPC-005.sentence: When the rekey completes, the timing runner SHALL measure warm and cold call time and peak memory on huginn and odin, each against its own baseline.

LPC-006.sentence: When `pos_plan_schedules` runs two run lengths under one `plan_d`, the node SHALL accept both runs.

LPC-007.sentence: When the rekey gives a leaf that proves more than 5 rules, the elastic demo SHALL prove one program at 1x, 2x, 4x and 8x run length under the same keys.

LPC-016.sentence: If a row reaches DONE without a lead verdict in `qa/gemini-quint`, then the tested-design loop SHALL count the row as not DONE for T15.

LPC-018.sentence: If a parent constraint of T3 never fires in a test, then the Carbon lane t3-airs SHALL add a forged input that fires it.

RKY-001.sentence: When the rekey runs, the rekey runner SHALL regenerate the `L`, `L_Fr` and wrap keys once from every row of `~/.cache/rekey-t11/LIST.md`.

RKY-002.sentence: If a row of the rekey list has no commit on its branch, then the rekey runner SHALL refuse to start.

RKY-005.sentence: When the rekey completes, the D3 calculator SHALL give every term at least 100 bits and every grindable term at least 101 bits on each new key.

RSL-001.sentence: When the rsl probe proves a leaf over the R_SL app proof of a suite call, the universal leaf key SHALL give an N1 pre-hash equal to the universal N1 pre-hash.

RSL-002.sentence: The R_SL chip set SHALL give every R_SL app 6 or 9 AIRs with FP-1.

RSL-003.sentence: When the suite prover runs the 142 R_SL suite calls, the R_SL app prover SHALL make one app proof per call that the stock verifier accepts.

RSL-004.sentence: Where the machine version has the keccak256 kit, when a circuit calls `keccak256`, the R_SL chip set SHALL prove the call inside the 6-or-9 AIR bucket.

RSL-005.sentence: Where the machine version has the secp256k1 kit, when a circuit calls `ec_mul`, `ec_mul_generator`, `into_coordinates` or `reconstitute_field` on secp256k1 values, the R_SL chip set SHALL prove the call inside the 6-or-9 AIR bucket.

RSL-006.sentence: When a circuit calls a jubjub operation, the R_SL chip set SHALL check `on_curve` and `in_subgroup` (`8Q = P`) with micro-op sequences and no new AIR.

RSL-007.sentence: When a circuit calls `persistentHash`, the R_SL chip set SHALL prove the hash on the SHA_IN and SHA_REQ AIRs with the openvm SHA-256 block hasher.

RSL-008.sentence: If an ALU or Poseidon input word of an R_SL row is not canonical, then the R_SL chip set SHALL refuse the row.

SQG-014.sentence: When G3 runs, the security gate SHALL compare the transcript vectors of the CPU prover, the GPU prover, the stark-backend verifier, `L` inside `L_Fr` and the wrap on the rekeyed keys.

SQG-015.sentence: When the rekey completes, the security gate SHALL run G4 with the `L_Fr` part, G1, G2, FP-8 and the ledger 9.1.0.1 check on the new keys.

SQG-016.sentence: If a RUNBOOK step is UNVERIFIED, then the security gate SHALL report the gate as not passed.

ZK-012.sentence: When the prover prepares a deployment, the prover SHALL draw `r_P` once from the OS CSPRNG and store it in `deploy.secret` with mode 0600.

ZK-013.sentence: When the prover prepares a run, the prover SHALL draw a fresh input salt and store it in `run.secret`.

ZK-014.sentence: If a build without the cargo feature `test-seed` receives `SHERLOCK_TEST_SEED`, `GW_DET`, `GW_CHIP_SEED` or `GW_SEED`, then the wrap prover SHALL exit with code 4 and write no proof.

ZK-015.sentence: When the wrap prover proves one statement twice, the wrap prover SHALL make two proofs that differ byte for byte and that the ledger 9.1.0.1 verifier accepts.

ZK-016.sentence: If a request to `wrapd serve` or to the STARK worker reuses a blinding slot, then the daemon SHALL refuse the request.

ZK-017.sentence: While the wrap runs on a GPU of odin or huginn, the GPU wrap prover SHALL take its blinders from `OsRng`.

ZK-018.sentence: If a configuration sends a leaf, node, `L`, `L_Fr` or wrap job to a host that the user does not own, then the prover SHALL refuse the configuration.

ZK-019.sentence: The SherlockSpec Lean library SHALL prove `pv2_inj` and `pv2_count_det` with no axiom outside `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`.

BXF-001.sentence: If a proving job names a host that is not in the owned-box roster of the user, then the job runner SHALL refuse the job.

BXF-002.sentence: When a prover, keygen or gate job starts on muninn, the job runner SHALL start the job through `heavy-slot`.

BXF-003.sentence: If a shared job asks for more memory than the heavy-slot budget, then the `heavy-slot` tool SHALL refuse the job.

BXF-004.sentence: While a GPU proving job runs on a box, the box runner SHALL hold an exclusive `flock` on `~/sherlock/gpu.lock`.

BXF-005.sentence: If `gpu.lock` is held for more than 10 minutes with no progress by the sampler or monitor of an ended job whose parent is gone, then the box agent SHALL log the holder on the bus and end it with SIGTERM.

BXF-006.sentence: If the holder of `gpu.lock` is a prover or a `wrapd` process, then the box agent SHALL leave the holder running.

BXF-007.sentence: When a result file moves between boxes, the receiving box SHALL check the sha256 of the file against the sha256 in the bus message.

BXF-008.sentence: When a box writes a line to its outbox, the `box-relay` unit SHALL append the line to `~/.cache/box-bus/all.log`.

BXF-009.sentence: When a run is planned to take more than 30 minutes, the job runner SHALL start the run as a `systemd-run --user` unit with a persistent log.

BXF-010.sentence: If the link to a box drops while the owner is away, then the lead agent SHALL move the queued jobs of that box to another box.

BXF-011.sentence: The timing runner SHALL state a speed gain from two runs on the same box.

BXF-012.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL read GPU data with `nvidia-smi --query-gpu` and the CUDA memory call and with no `nvidia-smi conf-compute` call.

BXF-013.sentence: If the same eligible orphan still holds `gpu.lock` 30 seconds after SIGTERM, then the box agent SHALL end it with SIGKILL.

BXF-014.sentence: If a file transfer between huginn and odin does not pass through muninn, then the box bus SHALL refuse the transfer.

CLB-001.sentence: The `L` interface SHALL expose 12,166 public words with 5 lane-map pairs.

CLB-002.sentence: If a call-vector effect lane holds a word that the guest did not write at that lane, then the `L` effect AIR SHALL refuse the witness.

CLB-003.sentence: If a chunked run states a chunk count `k` that differs from its slice count, then the `L` effect AIR SHALL refuse the witness.

CLB-004.sentence: The `L_Fr` interface SHALL use the ledger slot constant `ANCHOR_SLOT` = 15 for the anchor read of every call and for the anchor write of a chunk call.

CLB-005.sentence: If a chunk carries a lock whose operand `x_j` differs from `sponge(U_LOCK; c, pack(run_tag), k, d_in, d_out, pack(C_(j+1)), j)` of its run, with `C_(j+1)` the forward claim chain of the run after chunk `j` (ANC-019), then the `L_Fr` circuit SHALL refuse the chunk.

CLB-006.sentence: If an ordinary call (mode 0) carries the anchor-write template, then the interface decoder `iface::decode_with` SHALL refuse the call.

CLB-007.sentence: If a schedule cuts one call into more than `K_MAX` = 2 chunks, then the chunk planner SHALL refuse the call before a proof starts.

CLB-008.sentence: If the anchor slot constant of the `L_Fr` interface differs from the anchor slot constant of the wrap decoder, then the rekey runner SHALL refuse to start.

ELA-001.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL give a byte-equal `claim_pub` for every schedule of one prepared run of one deployment.

ELA-002.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL use the same app, leaf, N1, N2, N3 and `L` keys for every device, concurrency, cut and host of a run.

ELA-003.sentence: While at least one leaf shape fits the lowered memory budget, when the operator lowers the memory budget of a run, the Sherlock prover SHALL prove the run with the leaf concurrency that fits the lower budget.

ELA-004.sentence: While at least one leaf shape fits the CPU memory budget, if a box has no usable GPU, then the Sherlock prover SHALL prove the leaves on the CPU.

ELA-005.sentence: When muninn, huginn and odin each prove one prepared run with the profile of that box, the Sherlock prover SHALL give the same `claim_pub` on the three boxes.

ELA-006.sentence: When leaves proved on two owned boxes are combined under one N1, the Sherlock prover SHALL check each leaf with the stock verifier before it starts a node proof.

ELA-007.sentence: When an elastic run completes, the Sherlock prover SHALL write a run record with the box, the schedule, the shard count, the device and the wall time of each stage, the peak host memory, the stock verifier result and `claim_pub`.

GPH-001.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL prove programs of the interpreted rule family and programs of the straight-line family `R_SL_*` under the same universal key set.

GPH-002.sentence: When a run consumes the claim of an earlier run, the node prover SHALL verify the consumed claim through the GP-2 node modes MERGE, SEAL, SEAL-WITH-DEPS, DL-STEP, DESCEND and JOIN.

GPH-003.sentence: When a foreign-verifier unit proof is a child of N3, the N3 node SHALL accept the unit under the foreign rows of `keys_d`.

GPH-004.sentence: Where the X8 in-circuit Compact verifier is built, the foreign registry SHALL name the adapter class `compact-zkir3-kzg-bls12381-blake2b/1`.

GPH-005.sentence: When a proof-carrying-data tree of MERGE-WORK units of any shape is proved, the N3 node SHALL accept the root of the tree under the universal key set.

GPH-006.sentence: When a run suspends and resumes, the Sherlock prover SHALL give the `claim_pub` of the run without the suspension.

GPH-007.sentence: If a change removes a case of the GP case map or changes its expected outcome, then the gate runner SHALL fail the gate.

GPH-008.sentence: When the node root of a run is the SET root of a collection of claims, the `L` circuit SHALL expose the `claims_root` of that SET as a public word.

GPV-001.sentence: Where the build has the cargo feature `cuda`, the leaf prover SHALL prove app shards on the GPU through `openvm-cuda-backend`.

GPV-002.sentence: When the GPU prover and the CPU prover each prove one shard, the leaf prover SHALL give byte-equal public values on both.

GPV-003.sentence: Where the build has the cargo feature `gpu`, the `L_Fr` prover SHALL compute Poseidon hashes, the encoding and the fractional sumcheck with results equal to the CPU path.

GPV-004.sentence: Where the build has the cargo feature `cuda` and `T7_NODE_GPU` is not `0` or `off`, the node prover SHALL prove N1, N2 and N3 on the GPU.

GPV-005.sentence: Where the build has the cargo feature `cuda` and `T14_L_GPU` is not `off`, the `L` prover SHALL prove `L` on the GPU.

GPV-006.sentence: If a GPU proof of a shard fails with a device error, then the Sherlock prover SHALL stop the run and name the shard and the device.

GPV-007.sentence: Where the build has the cargo feature `cuda`, the leaf prover SHALL prove the leaf-layer proof of each shard on the GPU.

LTR-001.sentence: The `L` prover SHALL prove `L` as a STARK over BabyBear whose Merkle tree and transcript use Midnight Poseidon over the BLS12-381 scalar field.

LTR-002.sentence: The `L_Fr` prover SHALL prove `L_Fr` as a STARK whose base field is the BLS12-381 scalar field with no extension field.

LTR-003.sentence: If an `L` key has more than 2,200 columns or an AIR with more than 100 interactions, then the key generator SHALL refuse the key.

LTR-004.sentence: If an `L_Fr` tape does not expose the public words through `Tape::expose`, then the `L_Fr` machine SHALL refuse the tape.

LTR-005.sentence: The `L_Fr` tape SHALL replay the Fiat-Shamir transcript of `L` with outputs equal to the outputs of the stock transcript.

LTR-006.sentence: When the `L_Fr` prover completes a proof, the `L_Fr` prover SHALL publish one `LfrProofReady` record with the proof file path, the field `proof_sha256`, the `L_Fr` key pre-hash, the public words and `claim_pub`.

LTR-007.sentence: The `L` prover SHALL use the same `L` key and the same `L_Fr` key for a one-leaf run on path C and for a run on the full tree.

LTR-008.sentence: If the stock verifier refuses an `L_Fr` proof, then the `L_Fr` prover SHALL publish no `LfrProofReady` record for that proof.

LFP-001.sentence: The leaf prover SHALL prove every app shard and every leaf-layer proof as a STARK over BabyBear with the Poseidon2 configuration `BabyBearPoseidon2Config`.

LFP-002.sentence: When the leaf prover receives an `RslStatement` and its `ExecutionTrace`, the leaf prover SHALL make, for each shard, one app proof under R_SL chip set 3 and one leaf-layer proof whose N1 pre-hash equals the universal N1 pre-hash.

LFP-003.sentence: If the app shape of an R_SL program needs more than 8 app AIRs, then the leaf prover SHALL refuse the shape before it makes a proof.

LFP-004.sentence: If an app verifying key has more than 30,000 columns, then the leaf harness SHALL refuse the key.

LFP-005.sentence: The leaf prover SHALL prove every leaf shard with the ordered AIR height vector of its admitted shape.

LFP-006.sentence: The leaf AIR SHALL constrain the public value slot `PROG_D` to the `prog_d` of the program that the shard runs.

LFP-007.sentence: If a leaf proof carries a `prog_d` that differs from the `prog_d` of the run, then the N1 statement AIR SHALL refuse the leaf.

LFP-008.sentence: When a run has more steps than one leaf shape holds, the leaf prover SHALL add leaf shards and leave every per-program key and every universal key unchanged.

LFP-009.sentence: When the leaf prover completes the leaves of a run, the leaf prover SHALL publish one `LeafProofsReady` record that names each leaf proof file, its sha256, its public values and the `LeafKeyRef` of the run.

LFP-010.sentence: If the outcome commitment in the FP-1 public values of an R_SL app proof differs from the digest of `comm` and the ordered W of the PUBLIC rows of that proof, then the R_SL app AIR SHALL refuse the trace.

LFP-011.sentence: When the leaf prover proves a shard of an R_SL program, the leaf prover SHALL set the public value slot `PROG_D` to the `prog_d` of ERS-006 for that program.

LFP-012.sentence: If the digest of the tape that an R_SL app consumed differs from the `input_d` of the leaf statement, then the leaf AIR SHALL refuse the shard.

NAG-001.sentence: The node prover SHALL prove N1, N2 and N3 as STARKs over BabyBear at the `INTERNAL` parameter set.

NAG-002.sentence: If a child proof omits `StmtAir`, `ProofShapeAir` or `PublicValuesAir`, then the parent node SHALL refuse the child.

NAG-003.sentence: The N1 statement AIR SHALL open `prog_d` as `P2(DOM_PROG, image_d, plan_d, key_root, machine_version)` and forward `key_root` to its parent.

NAG-004.sentence: When the leaves of one run use more than one chip set of one `key_root`, the node prover SHALL merge the leaves under N2 and N3.

NAG-005.sentence: If a MERGE-WORK key has more than 5,400 columns, then the key generator SHALL refuse the key.

NAG-006.sentence: If a node witness is one of the forged inputs MW-F01, AFK-F7, GP2-F4.2 or the unlinked one-child MERGE-WORK node of AFK-F9(b), then the node AIRs SHALL refuse the witness.

NAG-007.sentence: If a node witness is the forged input of counterexample GP2-C2.1, then the node AIRs SHALL refuse the witness.

NAG-008.sentence: If the outcome word of a run differs from the outcome that the leaves proved, then the `L` circuit SHALL refuse the node root.

NAG-009.sentence: The N1 and N2 merge constraints SHALL check that the step interval of each child starts where the interval of the child before it ends and that its `pre_d` equals the `post_d` of the child before it.

NAG-010.sentence: When the node root of a run is proved, the node prover SHALL add each node proof path, its sha256 and its public values to the `ProofBundle` record of the run.

NAG-011.sentence: When an N1 witness carries a nonzero `reg_root` or a MERGE-WORK node has one linked child, the node AIRs SHALL accept the witness.

PDM-001.sentence: While `wrapd serve` runs, the prover daemon SHALL keep the SRS, the relation, the proving key, the verifying key, the fixed-base tables and the CUDA context loaded.

PDM-002.sentence: When the prover daemon starts, the prover daemon SHALL create its Unix socket with mode 0600 under `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`.

PDM-003.sentence: If a request names an operation other than `prove`, `call`, `stats` or `quit`, then the prover daemon SHALL answer with an error and keep serving.

PDM-004.sentence: While the STARK worker runs in serve mode, the STARK worker SHALL keep the STARK keys, the `L` key and the `L_Fr` key loaded on the device.

PDM-005.sentence: When the prover daemon serves a `prove` or `call` request, the prover daemon SHALL draw the blinders of that wrap proof from the OS CSPRNG inside the daemon process.

PDM-006.sentence: If a request names a key manifest sha256 that differs from the key set the daemon loaded, then the prover daemon SHALL refuse the request.

PDM-007.sentence: When a one-leaf call arrives at the prover daemon, the prover daemon SHALL serve the call on path C.

PDM-008.sentence: When the prover GUI bridge sends a `stats` request, the prover daemon SHALL answer with the stage, the shard counts and the stage times of the running call and with no witness word.

PDM-009.sentence: The prover daemon SHALL give a proof of statement X after a proof of statement Y the same distribution as a first proof of X, with no blinder of the earlier request in use.

STM-001.sentence: When the operator starts a setup run, the Sherlock prover SHALL read the GPU count and, for each GPU, its model name, compute capability, total memory, free memory and maximum SM clock.

STM-002.sentence: When a setup run finds a GPU that reports no own memory, the Sherlock prover SHALL record that GPU as unified.

STM-003.sentence: When the operator starts a setup run, the Sherlock prover SHALL read the CPU model, the usable core count, the total RAM, the free disk space of the output directory and, as the memory budget, the lower of `MemAvailable` and the cgroup headroom of the prover process.

STM-004.sentence: When the operator starts a setup run, the Sherlock prover SHALL prove one full-size leaf of each leaf shape of the universal key set on the CPU and on each GPU of a GPU build, with one warm-up proof and `T16_CAL_REPS` timed proofs.

STM-005.sentence: If the stock verifier refuses a calibration proof, then the Sherlock prover SHALL stop the setup mode and write no profile.

STM-006.sentence: When a setup run finishes, the Sherlock prover SHALL write one JSON profile with the fields `format` = `sherlock-profile/1`, `host`, `created`, `key_root`, `keys_d`, `gpus`, `cpu`, `memory`, `disk`, `calibration` and `setup_s`.

STM-007.sentence: If a profile has another `format` value, lacks a field or has a `leaf_s` that is not a finite positive time, then the Sherlock prover SHALL refuse the profile.

STM-008.sentence: If the `key_root` or `keys_d` of a profile differs from the universal key set of the prover, then the Sherlock prover SHALL record the run as not calibrated for this key set.

STM-009.sentence: When a run starts with a profile, the scheduler SHALL derive the leaf shape, the device, the leaf concurrency and the cut from the profile, the run length and the run-time limits.

STM-010.sentence: Where the operator sets `SHERLOCK_MEM_BUDGET`, `SHERLOCK_GPUS` or `SHERLOCK_GPU_MEM`, the scheduler SHALL use the lower of each limit and the profile value.

STM-011.sentence: The scheduler SHALL set the leaf concurrency to the number of leaves whose measured device bytes fit the free memory of the device and whose measured host bytes fit the host memory budget, with at most max(1, cores / 4) leaves on the CPU.

STM-012.sentence: If no leaf shape fits the memory budget on any device, then the scheduler SHALL refuse the run and name the reason.

STM-013.sentence: If a schedule has a shape with no key in the universal key set, a cut with no leaf, a cut that does not cover the run or a leaf outside 1 to S steps, then the scheduler SHALL refuse the schedule.

STM-014.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL accept a schedule without a list of admitted shard counts and without a menu of schedules.

STM-015.sentence: When the scheduler derives a schedule from a profile, the scheduler SHALL pick the wrap pipeline policy from the largest GPU memory of the profile less 1/16 headroom: full overlap with no eviction, else coset eviction with overlap after the quotient, else no overlap.

STM-016.sentence: Where `T16_PROFILE` is not set, the Sherlock prover SHALL read the box profile from `~/sherlock/setup/profile.json`.

STM-017.sentence: The scheduler SHALL pick the shape and device with the least estimated wall time, then the fewer leaves, then the lower shape index, then the GPU before the CPU.

STM-018.sentence: When the memory budget is lowered, the scheduler SHALL give a pick whose estimated wall time is not lower than the pick at the higher budget.

STM-019.sentence: If the free device bytes are below the STARK extra bytes plus the wrap tail plus the margin, then the device guard SHALL refuse the early wrap start.

SSG-001.sentence: When a per-program R_SL app key is generated, the D3 calculator SHALL print every term of the key at 100 bits or more.

SSG-002.sentence: The crates `sherlock-leaf` and `sherlock-lfr` SHALL have no dependency on a PLONK or KZG proving library.

SSG-003.sentence: If the counterexample record holds a row with verdict CONFIRMED and no fix commit, then the security gate SHALL report the gate as not passed.

SSG-004.sentence: If the counterexample record holds a row with verdict NOT ATTEMPTED, then the security gate SHALL list the row as open in the gate record.

SSG-005.sentence: When a circuit change lands on a lane branch after openvm c4bd312, the tested-design loop SHALL add one row with the commit, the AIR and the Quint lane to the circuit change list.

SSG-006.sentence: When G1 to G4, G5 and FP-8 pass on a key set, the security gate SHALL write a gate record with the key manifest sha256 and the log path of each check.

SSG-007.sentence: While the security gate has not passed on the key set in use, the Sherlock prover SHALL report the security status `not qualified` in every run record.

UKS-001.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL prove and verify every program of the Compact suite under one universal key set that has one internal-recursive key, one `L` key, one `L_Fr` key and one wrap key.

UKS-002.sentence: The key generator SHALL build `keys_d` from 7 node rows and the foreign rows of the universal key record.

UKS-003.sentence: When the rekey adds R_SL chip set 3 to `key_root`, the key generator SHALL give the R_SL key leaves an index that differs from the path C DAG leaf index `KEYDAG_IDX`.

UKS-004.sentence: When the rekey completes, the rekey runner SHALL write a universal key manifest that holds the sha256 of every universal key file, `keys_d`, the sha256 of `~/.cache/rekey-t11/LIST.md` and the openvm, stark-backend and Moriarty commits of the keygen tree.

UKS-005.sentence: If the key manifest of a box differs from the key manifest of the rekey, then the Sherlock prover on that box SHALL refuse to start a proof.

UKS-006.sentence: When the rekey completes, the rekey runner SHALL rerun the gates check-cases, V.9 omit, V.10 check-chain, pathc, pathc-d3, gp2, x7, d3work, iface-fixture, lfr-e3, i7-decode and sg6 on the new keys.

UKS-007.sentence: While the security gate of SSG-006 (G1 to G5 and FP-8) has not passed on a key set, the key manifest SHALL mark that key set as `prototype`.

UKS-008.sentence: The setup mode SHALL NOT make, change or select a key, a shape, `plan_d` or a value that enters a proof.

UKS-009.sentence: If the keygen tree of the rekey is not a descendant of every commit that `~/.cache/rekey-t11/LIST.md` names, then the rekey runner SHALL refuse to start.

UKS-010.sentence: If `~/.cache/rekey-t11/LIST.md` lacks a row for FP-3, the anchor slot 15, the canonical range checks, the R_SL statement bindings of LFP-010 to LFP-012, the R_SL key leaf index of UKS-003 or the era-check words, then the rekey runner SHALL refuse to start.

ZKE-001.sentence: If a build without the cargo feature `test-seed` reaches a code path that sets `r_P` from a constant, then the chain driver SHALL exit with code 4 and write no proof.

ZKE-002.sentence: If the prover binary of a run was built with the cargo feature `test-seed`, then the settlement runner SHALL refuse to submit the proof of that run to Preview.

ZKE-003.sentence: When a call is settled, the privacy scan SHALL find no witness word, no STARK proof bytes, no `r_P`, no input salt and no plain `prog_d` in the call vector, the transaction and the ledger state.

ZKE-004.sentence: If a file transfer of `deploy.secret`, `run.secret`, a witness file, an execution trace or a STARK proof names a destination host outside the owned-box roster of the user, then the box bus SHALL refuse the transfer.

ZKE-005.sentence: If `deploy.secret` of a deployed program is absent at call time, then the Sherlock prover SHALL refuse the call.

ZKE-006.sentence: The blinder types of the leaf crate SHALL print no secret word in their `Debug` output.

ZKE-007.sentence: When the wrap prover proves one statement twice on the CPU backend and twice on the GPU backend, the wrap prover SHALL give four proofs whose byte strings are pairwise not equal.

CLM-001.sentence: A `set_root` SHALL be the pinned-sponge hash of exactly one of `LEAF(claim_d, n_steps)`, `DEP(claim_d, n_steps, cover_root, in_link)`, `JOIN(l, r)`, `FOREIGN(fclaim_d)`, `ADM(adm_d)` and `VIEW(vw_d)`, with distinct domain words that differ from `SHK_RUN`, `SHK_DEPS` and every state and memory domain. This protocol SHALL NOT freeze before X12 passes (N-3).

CLM-002.sentence: Only the head claim of a verified SET SHALL be discharged. A SEG statement or a state digest SHALL NOT be consumed as a claim. The claim identity SHALL hold no address and no step count.

CLM-003.sentence: DESCEND SHALL derive `SUB(R, x)` from a verified SET `R` by one-hash openings of `JOIN` or `DEP` nodes. A head opening SHALL give the head claim and its `n_steps`. The discharge SHALL NOT depend on the batching shape of the producer.

CLM-004.sentence: `deps_d` SHALL start at `EMPTY_DEPS` and each consume event SHALL set `deps_d' = H(SHK_DEPS, deps_d, claim_d')`. SEAL-WITH-DEPS SHALL require `DL.chain_d` equal to the opened `deps_d`, with order and repetition. Plain SEAL SHALL refuse a non-empty chain.

CLM-005.sentence: If `DL.in_link = c_A` is set, SEAL-WITH-DEPS SHALL re-hash the consumer's `input_d` and `c_A` and SHALL require `outcome_d' == H(O, 1, 0, val_d)`. A Rejected or Exhausted claim SHALL be consumable as a chain element only, never as an input link or a value.

CLM-006.sentence: The built path SHALL be input consumption at the seal (AD-20 option a), with the circuit side of a mid-run consume rule specified so that it needs no new node relation. If the owner reads GP-2 as requiring a mid-run consume rule or a genesis-bound dependency, that work SHALL be required by this change and option (a) SHALL be only a milestone.

CLM-007.sentence: `DL` SHALL be `(chain_d, cover_root, in_link, prem_root)`. The premise element SHALL be the first element of a DL that a seal uses. It SHALL set `prem_root` and SHALL leave `chain_d`, `cover_root` and `in_link` unchanged. A chain element or an input-link element SHALL take only a `LEAF`, `DEP` or `FOREIGN` head.

CLM-008.sentence: The claim AIRs of the node SHALL meet the STARK kit gate SG-1 to SG-6 of `design.md` section 9 inside the internal set (height at most `2^19`, at most 1,000 constraints and 200 interactions per AIR, 64 AIRs, 3,000 columns), with every AIR required and a fixed height in its menu shape.

CLM-009.sentence: The GP-2 node modes SHALL be run on real proofs with an honest SEAL-WITH-DEPS: a consumer of chip set 2 whose input value is the Halted value of a producer of chip set 2, through SEAL, the DL-STEP input-link element and SEAL-WITH-DEPS, with a DEP output whose cover opens to the producer's claim. Each SEAL-WITH-DEPS refusal SHALL have a twin that differs from the honest case in one input.

CONT-001.sentence: The tier 1 scheduler SHALL keep a carry stack of proven SEGs by rank and SHALL merge two adjacent SEGs of equal rank with NODE MERGE. The fold order SHALL be a prover choice and SHALL NOT change the statement. Continuation mode 1 SHALL add no circuit cell and SHALL use only MERGE and SEAL.

CONT-002.sentence: A run stopped at height `h` and resumed from a validated checkpoint SHALL give the same `prog_d`, `input_d`, `outcome_d`, `n_steps` and `claim_d` as the uninterrupted run. The first suffix leaf SHALL have `h_pre = h` and `pre_d` equal to the record's `post_d`. Pause and resume SHALL execute no machine event.

CONT-003.sentence: A prefix SEG with a Running state SHALL NOT be sealed, sent to `L` as a run or consumed as a claim. Exhausted SHALL be terminal and SHALL NOT trigger a checkpoint.

CONT-004.sentence: The resume SHALL refuse, before any proving, a checkpoint whose manifest differs from the key manifest or whose bundle lacks a proof. Continuation mode 1 SHALL require Profile A. Mode 2 SHALL stay out of scope (AD-15).

CONT-005.sentence: Continuation mode 1 adds no AIR. Its positives and mutants SHALL be real proofs of NODE MERGE and SEAL nodes under the NODE key set of NODE-014, checked by the stock verifier (SG-2, SG-3). Its host refusals SHALL stay host tests.

FREG-001.sentence: A foreign proof SHALL enter only through an entry `entry_d` of the version `sherlock-reg-entry/1` that binds proof system, curve, commitment scheme, SRS id, verifying-key digest, transcript id, public-input schema and count, adapter digest and policy, opened under `reg_root` at the fixed schema depth. `pi_count` SHALL be below `2^32`.

FREG-002.sentence: The foreign lift SHALL prove membership of both the adapter key and the inner foreign key in `reg_root`, SHALL require the adapter verification and the inner verification to complete in circuit (FVR-003) with no accumulator folded, and SHALL emit `fclaim_d = H(SHK_CLAIM, KIND_FOREIGN, vk_id_inner, adapter_id, out_d)` with a domain disjoint from `SHK_RUN`.

FREG-003.sentence: The adapter SHALL consume the verified public inputs as `pi_d` and SHALL derive `out_d` from them. A foreign field SHALL become a value digest only through the authenticated adapter relation. Proof parsing SHALL refuse trailing or missing data.

FREG-004.sentence: The native adapter path SHALL be a milestone task, scoped by X8 (N-10). No foreign proof SHALL be folded into an accumulator, under any SRS (FVR-003). GP-3 SHALL be reported complete only with the general verifier evidence of `sherlock-foreign-verifier`. An adapter-only GP-3 SHALL NOT be an acceptance path.

FREG-005.sentence: The foreign-lift AIRs of the node SHALL meet the STARK kit gate SG-1 to SG-6 of `design.md` section 9 inside the internal set (height at most `2^19`, at most 1,000 constraints and 200 interactions per AIR, 64 AIRs, 3,000 columns), with every AIR required and a fixed height in its menu shape.

FVR-001.sentence: The general verifier SHALL verify a proof of any registered PLONK or halo2 circuit on the same curve and commitment scheme in FV-WORK units. Each unit SHALL continue `fv_state_d = H(SHK_FV, entry_d, phase, cursor, transcript_d, acc_d, pi_d, consumed_d, work_root)` of its child and SHALL do at most the unit budget of X14. All units SHALL consume one proof stream in order.

FVR-002.sentence: FV-SCHED SHALL emit the foreign SET in the `FOREIGN` form only at `phase = DONE`, after every phase. The adapter SHALL be applied to `pi_d` only. Challenges SHALL come from the registered transcript and points SHALL pass their encoding checks.

FVR-003.sentence: FV-FINAL SHALL check every foreign proof, under the core SRS or under another SRS, fully in circuit in work units with the verifier parameters of its registry entry, with nothing deferred to `L` or the wrap (AD-22 option a). The STARK node folds no accumulator (NODE-004, NODE-007), so no foreign obligation SHALL be folded into an accumulator. A second deferred accumulator per SRS SHALL be used only by owner decision.

FVR-004.sentence: FV-PARSE, FV-TRANSCRIPT, FV-ARITH, FV-FINAL and FV-SCHED SHALL NOT start before X14 gives the operation inventory and the unit budget. One unit plus the verification of one `FV` child SHALL fit the node shape bounds of the internal set, with at most 3,300 columns and the 17-bit range checker for FV work units only (rulings O1 and O2). If no unit size fits, GP-3 SHALL stay incomplete and the scope SHALL NOT be reduced to adapter classes.

FVR-005.sentence: `work_root` SHALL be an indexed store of typed records `(index, kind, value)`, empty at the first unit. FV-PARSE SHALL write each element at index `cursor`. FV-TRANSCRIPT SHALL write each challenge at its schema index. FV-ARITH and FV-FINAL SHALL read elements and challenges only by openings against `work_root`. FV-SCHED SHALL own the index schema per `transcript_id` and SHALL allow `DONE` only with every scheduled record written.

FVR-006.sentence: The FV work-unit AIRs SHALL meet SG-1 to SG-6 of `design.md` section 9 inside the internal set, except that a unit MAY use at most 3,300 columns and the 17-bit range checker (owner rulings O1 and O2 of 2026-11-13). No other kit SHALL use these two exceptions.

NODE-001.sentence: MERGE SHALL take two SEGs with equal `prog_d`, `L.post_d == R.pre_d` and `L.h_hi == R.h_lo`, and SHALL output `(prog_d, L.pre_d, R.post_d, L.h_lo, R.h_hi)`. A unary MERGE SHALL pass its child through. A LEAF child SHALL count as the SEG `(prog_d, pre_d, post_d, h_pre, h_pre + steps)`.

NODE-002.sentence: NODE SHALL range-check `h_lo` and `h_hi` below `2^64` as `u64` lanes of four 16-bit limbs, each limb a RANGE query (FP-1). For a LEAF child NODE SHALL check `1 <= steps <= S_MAX` and `h_pre + steps < 2^64` (SRC-004). The halo2 rule of 8-bit bytes with no new range-table tag is history (DG-007).

NODE-003.sentence: SEAL SHALL require `h_lo == 0`, a terminal opened `outcome_tag` and `deps_d == EMPTY_DEPS` from `open_state_header(post_d)`. It SHALL output `set_root = H(SHK_SET_LEAF, claim_d, n_steps)` with `claim_d = H(SHK_RUN, 1, prog_d, input_d, outcome_d)` and `n_steps = h_hi`, and no physical state field. The opening SHALL be measured by X10 (AD-19). SEAL and SEAL-WITH-DEPS SHALL be the only seal path. `L` SHALL open the sealed SET head and SHALL NOT check a seal predicate again (FPR-007, FPR-013).

NODE-004.sentence: Each child slot SHALL have `en_j` boolean and a one-hot `key_sel_j` over {LEAF, NODE, FOREIGN} that sums to `en_j`. One selector SHALL bind the child key, its permitted `stmt_tag` and its statement lanes. The recursion verifier SHALL verify every enabled child proof, and each child key SHALL be committed: a LEAF key triple by a path into `key_root`, a NODE or FOREIGN key `vkc` by a row of the universal table under `keys_d` (T7). A disabled slot SHALL use the canonical neutral statement.

NODE-005.sentence: The node SHALL accept only the rows MERGE, MERGE-WORK, SEAL, SEAL-WITH-DEPS, DL-STEP, DESCEND, JOIN, FV-WORK, ADMIT-WORK and VIEW-WORK of the kit's relation table. Every other combination of `stmt_tag`s, enables and work kind SHALL be unsatisfiable. Administrative modes SHALL execute no owner step and SHALL NOT change a height.

NODE-006.sentence: The node key and its relation record SHALL bind `S_MAX`, every keyed capacity and the child key representations (SRC-014). The halo2 fields of `write_relation` (the column count and `k`) SHALL be replaced by the AIR list, the per-AIR column and interaction counts and the trace heights of the shape. The landed lane name `rule` SHALL be renamed `rules_d`. The leaf entry form (direct leaf key or one-leaf lift) SHALL be decided by X7 (N-1).

NODE-007.sentence: The STARK node SHALL have a fixed arity, at most 4 (LD-S10x-2), and SHALL stay inside the internal set: height at most `2^19`, at most 1,000 constraints and 200 interactions per AIR, 64 AIRs and 3,000 columns (owner rulings 2026-11-12 20:35, `DA` lines 81 and 82, which override the 100 interactions, 50 AIRs and 2,000 columns of the section 1.9 table). Keygen SHALL refuse a node outside them. Its cost SHALL be recorded in seconds per proof (DG-004, DG-006).

NODE-008.sentence: `reg_root` SHALL be equal in every enabled NODE or FOREIGN child and in the parent. A LEAF child SHALL carry no `reg_root`. With no enabled NODE or FOREIGN child, the parent SHALL take `reg_root` from its witness. The constraint SHALL be `en_j * (1 - is_leaf_j) * (child_j.reg_root - parent.reg_root) == 0` for `j` in {0, 1}.

NODE-009.sentence: The key selector SHALL permit `LEAF -> {SEG, LG}` (LG for the discharge child only, FPR-006), `FOREIGN -> {SET}` and `NODE -> {SEG, SET, SUB, DL, FV, AW, VW}`. The FV payload SHALL be `(fv_state_d)` only. The registry root of an FV statement SHALL be the node's `reg_root` lane.

NODE-010.sentence: SEAL SHALL take a verified SET or SUB child in slot 1 whose root `prem_root` opens with one hash as `ADM(adm_d)`, with `adm_d == H(SHK_ADM, 1, prog_d)` for the sealed `prog_d`. SEAL-WITH-DEPS SHALL apply the same check to `DL.prem_root`. This check SHALL be the discharge point of the PROG canonicality premise.

NODE-011.sentence: ADMIT-WORK SHALL continue `adm_state_d = H(SHK_ADM_STATE, prog_d, prog_root, tbl, row)` of its child, or open `prog_d` at the first unit. Each unit SHALL check, in order, at most the unit budget of ROM rows: constant `vd`, `ty_d` of the AD-14 normal form, constructor ordinal and arity, reference ranges and canonical padding. It SHALL emit `ADM(adm_d)` only after the last row.

NODE-012.sentence: Under input admission form (b) (AD-17, OWNER), VIEW-WORK SHALL continue `view_state_d = H(SHK_VIEW_STATE, val_d, view_root, cursor, n_rec, fold_d)` of its child. Each unit SHALL check view records in index order against `sherlock-value/1`, with record 0 equal to `val_d`. It SHALL emit `VIEW(vw_d)`, `vw_d = H(SHK_VIEW, 1, val_d, view_root)`, only after the last record.

NODE-013.sentence: Under form (b), for every re-hashed `val_d` other than the absent-input constant, the seal premise SHALL open as `JOIN(ADM(adm_d), VIEW(vw_d))`. `vw_d` SHALL equal `H(SHK_VIEW, 1, val_d, view_root)`, with `val_d` from the re-hashed `input_d` preimage and `view_root` the header word that `open_state_header` returns (FPR-012).

NODE-014.sentence: The node AIRs SHALL meet the STARK kit gate SG-1 to SG-6 of `design.md` section 9 inside the internal set (height at most `2^19`, at most 1,000 constraints and 200 interactions per AIR, 64 AIRs, 3,000 columns), with every AIR required and a fixed height in its menu shape.

NODE-015.sentence: The MERGE-WORK key SHALL be one more universal key with a row in the `keys_d` table. Ordinary nodes SHALL stay inside the internal set with 3,000 columns. Only the MERGE-WORK key SHALL use the set `merge_work`.

SHP-001.sentence: JOIN SHALL compute `set_root = H(SHK_SET_JOIN, l.set_root, r.set_root)` with no counter and no range check, at any depth (R-5, AD-2 OWNER to confirm). A claim MAY be reused in two branches. One key set SHALL prove a chain, a balanced tree and a DAG with equal final proof size.

SHP-002.sentence: `shape_d` SHALL be `H(SHK_SHAPE, T_NODE, mode, slot_bits, key_sel_0, key_sel_1, shape_0, shape_1, work_kind, work_steps, out_a, out_b)` in this order. No field SHALL be `pre_d`, `post_d`, `body_d`, a memory root, a tail digest, a challenge or an address. Acceptance, replay and consumption SHALL NOT use `shape_d`. Bracketing disclosure SHALL follow N-7.

SHP-003.sentence: MERGE-WORK SHALL take one or two enabled prior SEG proofs plus `k >= 1` real owner steps in one node, with `W.pre_d` equal to the right-most child's `post_d`, `W.h_pre` equal to its `h_hi`, and output height `W.h_pre + k` below `2^64`. Two successive nodes SHALL NOT satisfy this requirement. Its fit SHALL be measured by X7 (N-6, OWNER).

SHP-004.sentence: A LEAF child SHALL have `shape_j = H(SHK_SHAPE, T_LEAF, h_pre, steps)` from its authenticated lanes. A FOREIGN child SHALL forward `H(SHK_SHAPE, T_FOREIGN, fclaim_d)`. A disabled slot SHALL have the fixed non-zero constant `SHAPE_OFF = H(SHK_SHAPE, T_OFF, 0)`.

SHP-005.sentence: `(out_a, out_b)` SHALL be `(h_lo, h_hi)` for a SEG output, `(set_root, 0)` for a SET, `(chain_d, cover_root)` for a DL, `(set_root, sub_root)` for a SUB and `(0, 0)` for an FV, AW or VW output. A FOREIGN SET at FV completion, and an `ADM` or `VIEW` SET at the completion of ADMIT-WORK or VIEW-WORK, SHALL use the SET rule `(set_root, 0)` (`FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` kit GP-4 hook). `fv_state_d` SHALL NOT enter `shape_d`.

SHP-006.sentence: The inline kernel SHALL be built from the same kit `KitAir` and `KitTrace` implementations as the leaf (CORE, DEC, ALU, RANGE, HASH, STACKS, MEM, the memory backend, VALUE DIGEST, INIT), instantiated in the node's AIR set inside the internal set bounds (SG-4). A separate node emitter SHALL NOT be used. If the kernel does not fit the node shape bounds, the owner SHALL decide under N-6 and GP-4 SHALL NOT be narrowed.

SHP-007.sentence: The shape and MERGE-WORK AIRs of the node SHALL meet the STARK kit gate SG-1 to SG-6 of `design.md` section 9 inside the internal set (height at most `2^19`, at most 1,000 constraints and 200 interactions per AIR, 64 AIRs, 3,000 columns; the MERGE-WORK key inside its own set, SHP-008), with every AIR required and a fixed height in its menu shape.

SHP-008.sentence: The MERGE-WORK key SHALL meet the STARK kit gate inside its own set `merge_work` (owner ruling N-6 "own bounds", 2026-11-14), not inside the internal set. The set SHALL have the internal parameters and per-AIR bounds and 5,400 columns. The inline CORE SHALL be split into CORE and FRAME from one frame rule, so that no AIR has more than 1,000 constraints.

SHP-009.sentence: The `keys_d` table SHALL have seven rows (`UROWS` 7): the four rows of T8 and the rows NW over the MERGE-WORK key, NW2 over NW and N3 over NW2. NW and NW2 SHALL be the universal node circuit keyed over their children, and a node over NW2 SHALL have the N3 key. A child proof SHALL be accepted only at its own `keys_d` row (T8b AFK pick; it changes `keys_d` and so rekeys `L` and `L_Fr`).

ANC-001.sentence: The anchor cell SHALL be the top-level ledger slot 15, a key constant of the wrap (`ANCHOR_SLOT`, template lanes 6 and 15). It SHALL hold `C_P = H(SHK_PROGC, r_P, prog_d)`, with one salt `r_P` per deployment, or a lock value `A_j`. It SHALL NOT hold plain `prog_d`. User code SHALL NOT address slot 15.

ANC-002.sentence: The anchor values SHALL be `A_0 = A_k = C_P` and `A_j = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_LOCK, x_j)` for `1 <= j < k`, with the lock operand `x_j = sponge(U_LOCK; c, pack(run_tag), k, d_in, d_out, pack(C_(j+1)), j)` over Fr (HDM-001 use code 8), where `C_(j+1)` is the forward claim chain of the run's call records after chunk `j` (FP-3, ANC-019). `run_tag` SHALL be a fresh salted value per run (OD-16).

ANC-003.sentence: Every call SHALL carry the anchor statement `(mode, j, k, a_in, a_out)`. An ordinary call SHALL have `mode` ORD with `a_in = a_out = C_P` and no anchor write. Chunk `j` of `k` SHALL have `mode` CHUNK with `a_in = A_(j-1)` and `a_out = A_j`. It SHALL write `ins anchor := a_out` in the effect region (OD-16).

ANC-004.sentence: One logical call SHALL run as `k` contract calls in one intent of one transaction on the unmodified ledger. Chunk `j` SHALL claim chunk `j+1`. The anchor lock SHALL hold between chunks.

ANC-005.sentence: Mode 1F SHALL put all chunks in the fallible part of one segment. A failure of a middle chunk SHALL leave the contract state unchanged. The transaction SHALL be included with its fee paid.

ANC-006.sentence: Mode 1G SHALL put all chunks in the guaranteed part, for a callee of a guaranteed caller. A failure SHALL make the transaction invalid. A chain that mixes fallible and guaranteed chunks SHALL be refused.

ANC-007.sentence: The frontend SHALL cut a run only where the native run has stack depth exactly 3, at a boundary that the run certifies. The slice shard SHALL check the cut (R-cut). Every read of context slot 0 and effects slot 1 SHALL be hoisted into a prologue in chunk 1 (R-ctx).

ANC-008.sentence: A chunked call SHALL have no dropped suffix, no dropped prefix and no interleaving inside or outside its intent. Replay SHALL be bound through `binding_input`. Fees SHALL be checked for the whole transaction before application.

ANC-009.sentence: A hybrid contract SHALL have a second cell `anchor_home` that deploy sets to `C_P` and that no entry writes. A native-routed entry SHALL start with the uncached reads `popeq anchor` and `popeq anchor_home`. Its circuit SHALL assert that the two values are equal (OD-8, OD-16).

ANC-010.sentence: The chunk tests SHALL run in order: T1 at ledger level with 13 cases and no proofs, T2 on the XC-9 devnet with `chunky.compact` and the controls T2-N and T2-N0, then T3 with universal-key chunks after frontend M5. Under placement V, `bind_label` SHALL compute the claim address and `ep_hash` of each chunk from the pinned windows (FPR-014, LEAD F-13), and the run SHALL write `(addr_c, ep_hash, comm_(j+1))` into the effect words of its `claimContractCall`.

ANC-011.sentence: The anchor and chunk rules SHALL be reported proved only when CF-L2 is proved with an axiom report that holds only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`.

DG-001.sentence: No BLS12-381 circuit of the co-processor SHALL be keyed above k = 21 (CPR-001).

DG-002.sentence: The wrap SHALL fit 85 percent of the `2^k - 7` usable rows at the smallest k of 19, 20 and 21 at which the measured wrap rows fit. The wrap SHALL use the `ZkStdLib` chips (LW-013). The k of the key SHALL be fixed by the measured rows of the stdlib wrap of `L_Fr` at step E5 (M7, D15).

DG-003.sentence: The wrap verifier key SHALL be at most 50,000 bytes (MID-003).

DG-004.sentence: Every STARK shard SHALL have a fixed shape from the plan menu. Keygen SHALL refuse a key outside the shape bounds of its layer (SQG-002).

DG-005.sentence: `L` SHALL have a height of at most `2^20`. Its stacked width SHALL be at most 48 with `mu` PoW 6 (OD-19; frozen by owner decision 2026-11-12), with D10's measured `w_stack` 18 on `L_cached` inside it (SQG-005).

DG-006.sentence: STARK leaves and nodes SHALL have no fixed row gate. Their cost SHALL be recorded in seconds per proved step on the GPU, with the run record.

DG-007.sentence: The halo2 row gates `k_leaf <= 16` at S = 16, node at most 950,000 rows and decider at most 1,000,000 rows SHALL NOT be gates of the co-processor. Row figures of the halo2 prototypes in `crates/mori-chip` and `crates/mori-recursion` SHALL be read as prototype figures only.

DG-008.sentence: A constraint test of a STARK AIR SHALL run the stark-backend debug constraint checker. A constraint test of the wrap circuit or of a halo2 prototype SHALL run MockProver. Every named mutant SHALL be refused at the constraint, lookup or permutation boundary. Every named mutant SHALL have a weakened control that accepts the same witness.

DG-009.sentence: At the constraint boundary the node SHALL accept a height of `2^64 - 1` and refuse `2^64`. Real proofs SHALL pass the independent verifier of SRC-010 and `validate_call` with the five mutations of SRC-020 refused.

DG-010.sentence: A failed derived gate SHALL leave its GP target open. It SHALL go to the owner. It SHALL NOT narrow GP-001 to GP-004 or GP-ZK (CPR-005).

DG-011.sentence: The design lists no Lean obligation for the derived gates. Each gate SHALL be met by a measurement or a keygen check with its record.

FLG-001.sentence: A log entry SHALL be `e = (op, inputs, outputs)`. Each Fr value SHALL be 9 limbs of 30 bits with `dec(x) < r`. The operation list SHALL be `PERM`, `H2`, `SPONGE(n)`, `PATH(d)`, `ECMUL`, `ECMULG`, `PUB(i)`, `DIGEST` and `NOP`. `FADD`, `FMUL`, `FINV` and `ECADD` SHALL NOT be deferred.

FLG-002.sentence: The log digest SHALL be the tagged onion in Poseidon2 over BabyBear: `d_0 = P2(TAG_EMPTY)` and `d_(i+1) = P2(tagStep, d_i, P2(tagEnt, enc(e_i)))`. The pair `(d, n)` SHALL be carried in the boundary state through leaves, continuations, suspension and resume. Nodes SHALL merge child digests by `TAG_NODE`.

FLG-003.sentence: The capacity SHALL be four wrap key constants: `B` entries, `V` logged values, `P` permutation slots and `E` Jubjub slots. The values SHALL be `B = V = P = 256` and `E = 0` (OD-6, OD-17).

FLG-004.sentence: `pv` SHALL be an entry table of `B` rows `(op, param)` and a value table of `V` rows of 9 limbs, so `W_pv = 2B + 9V` = 2,816 words (OD-17). Offsets SHALL NOT be words of `pv`. Unused entry rows SHALL be `NOP` with `param` 0. No used entry SHALL follow a `NOP`. Unused value rows SHALL be zero.

FLG-005.sentence: Each operation SHALL use the value, permutation and Jubjub slots of the table of `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.8. `SPONGE(n)` SHALL have `1 <= n <= V - 1`. `PATH(d)` SHALL have `1 <= d <= 32`. `ECMUL` and `ECMULG` SHALL NOT be admitted while `E = 0`. `PUB(i)` SHALL have `0 <= i < 2 + L_TX`. A `DIGEST` tag SHALL come from the frozen tag list (HDM-002).

FLG-006.sentence: The reservation `R` SHALL be the anchor reservation `R_A` plus the public-digest `DIGEST` entries of the statement. `R` SHALL depend only on the mode and the statement. The planner, `L` and the wrap SHALL place `R` first. Keygen SHALL refuse a capacity that does not hold the largest `R` of 4 entries, 8 values and 4 permutations.

FLG-007.sentence: A discretionary operation SHALL enter the log only if every limit and its bound still hold for `R` and the discretionary set together. Every other discretionary Fr operation SHALL be proved inline by tier E. Such an operation SHALL NOT be refused. A consumed claim SHALL close in a discharge shard of a fixed leaf shape.

FLG-008.sentence: `L` SHALL recompute the digest from the private flattened log and its tree shape. `L` SHALL bind each table of `pv` to its part of the public-value vector by its own multilinear extension. The Fr transcript of `L` SHALL absorb all of `pv` before the first challenge.

FLG-009.sentence: The field log SHALL be reported proved only when the two-table encoding is part of a built `wrap_refines` (BR-L2) and ZK-L2 is proved, each with an axiom report that holds only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`. Premises A3 (`rootBinds`), A4 (`recSound`) and A5 (`p2Inj`) SHALL stay named hypotheses.

FPR-001.sentence: Every lane of a bus message, a port message, a public value and a digest preimage SHALL have one type of `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.11, FP-1: `bit`, `tag(w)` with `w <= 16` and `u16` in one word; `u32` in 2, `u64` in 4, `addr` in `ceil((TOP + 3) / 16)` and `u128` in 8 little-endian 16-bit limbs; `digest` in 8 words; `fr` in 9 30-bit limbs with `Canon`. The writer SHALL range-check every limb. No word SHALL hold two typed fields (LEAD F-1).

FPR-002.sentence: Chip id `c` SHALL be the stark-backend bus index `BUS_BASE + c`, with `BUS_BASE` above every bus index of a stock OpenVM chip of the chip set. Ids 1 to 6 SHALL be ALU, MEM, HASH, ROM, RANGE and DEC with the message layouts of `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.11, FP-1. Ids 7 to 15 SHALL have no provider. A disabled request SHALL have count 0. The L-6 tag SHALL be the bus index. Every DEC slot SHALL query with count 1, a disabled slot on the idle row `(0, 0)` (LEAD F-2).

FPR-003.sentence: A port whose producer and consumer are columns of one AIR SHALL be shared columns of one row. A port between two AIRs SHALL be a `PermutationCheckBus` of index `BUS_BASE + 16 + j`, with `j` the position of the port in the ports manifest. The producer SHALL send `(seq, cells)` with count `act`, and the consumer SHALL receive the same message with count `act`, with `seq: u32` the leaf-local event index (LEAD F-2).

FPR-004.sentence: Each bus of ids 1 to 6 SHALL be a `LookupBus`: a request with a boolean count, a provider with a witness multiplicity. A message with its bus index SHALL have at most 128 words. For each bus, the sum of `count_weight` times height SHALL be below `p`, and the sum of interactions times height SHALL be below `p`. Each kit SHALL implement `KitAir` and `KitTrace` of FP-1 and SHALL use only `request`, `provide`, `port_send` and `port_recv` across AIRs.

FPR-005.sentence: Every node proof SHALL expose the 74 words of FP-2: `stmt_tag`, a 32-word payload, `key_root`, `reg_root`, `shape_d`, `log_d`, `log_n` and `keys_d`. A log with `log_n = 0` SHALL be `(D_EMPTY, 0)`. The output log SHALL be `merge(merge(c_0, c_1), w)` in every mode but DISCHARGE (FPR-018): an empty operand is neutral, two non-empty logs give `(P2(TAG_NODE, d_a, d_b), n_a + n_b)`,, output `n` below `2^16`. A disabled slot SHALL contribute `(D_EMPTY, 0)`, and administrative modes no entry (LEAD F-3).

FPR-006.sentence: For a LEAF child, the node SHALL open `prog_d` to `key_root` and SHALL prove the child's key leaf `P2(DOM_KEYTRIPLE, set_id, c_app, c_leaf, c_ifl)` in it at depth 16. Every enabled NODE child SHALL have the parent's `keys_d`; a SEG child, the parent's `key_root` (LEAD F-5). A DISCHARGE node SHALL require the LG statement of its slot-1 LEAF to equal the log of slot 0, and SHALL output the slot-0 statement with the log `(D_EMPTY, 0)` (LEAD F-4).

FPR-007.sentence: `L` SHALL open the sealed SET head of a general run with one Poseidon2 hash over BabyBear and SHALL recompute `claim_d` from its witnessed preimage (LW-008, LEAD F-6). The wrap SHALL compute no BabyBear Poseidon2 for the head.

FPR-008.sentence: `L` SHALL expose its public values in the order of the FP-3 index table: the root statement, the anchor statement `(mode, j, k, e_in, e_out)`, `run_tag`, `layout_d`, `X`, a lane map of 4 `(lane, entry)` pairs, `pv` and the call vector of `2 + L_TX` `fr` lanes. The wrap SHALL require each mapped lane to equal the output of its `DIGEST` entry. The entry label bound by lane 0 SHALL discriminate the run statement from the collection statement (LEAD F-8).

FPR-009.sentence: The freeze proposal SHALL NOT freeze the public statement codec while these facts are missing, and SHALL name them: the carrier of the effect region and `comm` from the terminal state of a run of more than one shard to the call vector of `L`; the call-vector lanes of the run statement and of the collection statement, which follow from the compiled LEDGER CONTRACT; and the contract-side form of a collection opening under `sherlock-value/2`, with the `openClaim` key and its public `n_steps`.

FPR-010.sentence: The public digests SHALL be `C_P = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_PROGC, pack(P2(DOM_PROGC, r_P, prog_d)))`, `input_pub = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_INPUT, pack(input_d))`, `outcome_pub = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_OUTCOME, pack(P2(DOM_OUTHIDE, input_d, outcome_d)))` and `claim_pub = transientHash([C_P, input_pub, outcome_pub])`. The salt SHALL be 8 words from the user's CSPRNG in `input_d`, fixed for the run at INIT (LEAD F-7, F-10).

FPR-011.sentence: Every internal digest SHALL be `P2(tag, words)` with the tag code of FP-4, the tag word first and the length `1 + l` in the capacity. `image_d`, `prog_d`, `vd`, `input_d`, `outcome_d`, `claim_d`, `fclaim_d`, `adm_d`, `vw_d`, the SET forms, `deps_d`, `state_d` and `body_d` SHALL have the preimage order of the FP-4 table. Each constant SHALL be the hash of its tag alone. VALUE DIGEST, HASH and INIT SHALL compute these forms in place of their `sherlock-value/1` forms (LEAD F-9).

FPR-012.sentence: `state_d` SHALL be `P2(SHK_SD2, outcome_tag, outcome_payload, input_d, deps_d, view_root, body_d)`. INIT SHALL set `view_root` from the witness under AD-17 form (b) (owner decision 2026-11-12), and to `VIEW_NONE` for an absent input; no rule SHALL write it. SEAL and SEAL-WITH-DEPS SHALL compare the opened `view_root` with the `view_root` of the `VIEW` claim (LEAD F-11).

FPR-013.sentence: `n_steps` SHALL NOT be in the run statement, the call vector, `acceptRun` or the `runs` map. It SHALL stay private as `h_hi` of the sealed segment inside the SET forms `LEAF` and `DEP`. For a collection this SHALL hold only when FPR-009 fixes the contract-side opening (LEAD F-12; the `n_steps` rule and the amendments of SRC-006, SRC-007 and LDG-001 are owner items).

FPR-014.sentence: `bind_label` SHALL require `offset = |domain| + 32`, SHALL take `addr_c = m[|domain| .. |domain| + 32)`, and SHALL compute `ep_hash = SHA256(EP_OPEN || lab)` on the `sha2` chip, with `EP_OPEN` the bytes `"midnight:entry-point"` and 12 zero bytes and `lab` the label bytes without the SCALE length prefix. A chunk `j < k` SHALL write `(addr_c, ep_hash, comm_(j+1))` into the effect words of its `claimContractCall` (LEAD F-13).

FPR-015.sentence: Under placement V, `m` SHALL be a tape byte array of the per-entry length `M_B(e)` from `abi.json`, with the true length `len_m: u32` on the tape and zero bytes after it. The window offsets SHALL be absolute. `bind_label` SHALL run `ceil((M_B(e) + 9) / 64)` compressions and SHALL select the chaining value after block `ceil((len_m + 9) / 64)` as the digest.

FPR-016.sentence: The freeze interfaces SHALL be reported proved only when `bus_enc_inj`, `node_log_merge` (every mode except DISCHARGE), `node_discharge_sound`, `node_key_route`, `digest_table_inj`, `header_open_sound`, `run_view_no_nsteps` and `bind_label_sound` are proved with an axiom report that holds only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`, with premises A4 and A5 as hypotheses.

FPR-017.sentence: Every co-processor interface, kit interface and universal key SHALL have one status in `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.12: FROZEN, when every input is settled in the named design text, or FREEZE-PENDING with its named gates (FZ-1, owner confirmed 2026-11-12). No row SHALL reach FROZEN by a choice of the freeze itself. The FROZEN rows SHALL be interface version 1. No universal key SHALL be FROZEN before FP-8 closes, (FPR-019).

FPR-018.sentence: DISCHARGE SHALL be exempt from the concatenation rule of FPR-005. Its invariant SHALL be: every entry of the flattened slot-0 log satisfies `Valid`, proved in the discharge leaf; the output log is `(D_EMPTY, 0)`; and every output word other than `log_d` and `log_n` equals the word of slot 0 (FZ-6, owner confirmed 2026-11-12). Lean `node_discharge_sound` SHALL state this invariant.

FPR-019.sentence: FP-8 SHALL NOT close while an interface that a universal key embeds is FREEZE-PENDING: FP-3 facts 1 to 3 with their closure tests, the path C key binding of I-17, the option E path of OD-24 through E5, D10 and ENC-1 to ENC-5 (FZ-4, owner confirmed 2026-11-12).

CPR-001.sentence: No BLS12-381 circuit of the co-processor SHALL have k = 22 or above. The wrap SHALL take k = 19, 20 or 21.

CPR-002.sentence: Every proof of the co-processor SHALL be a fixed-size shard of a shape from the plan menu. Work SHALL grow by adding shards. No key constant SHALL bound the run length or the Fr work.

CPR-003.sentence: One universal key set SHALL accept every program: the internal-recursive key, the `L` key and the wrap key. Per-program keys SHALL sit under `key_root` inside `prog_d`. A new program SHALL need no new universal key.

CPR-004.sentence: The co-processor SHALL need no change of the ledger 9.1.0.1 verifier. The wrap SHALL be checked by `VerifierKey::verify` as the ledger runs it today. Ledger 9 refuses a key with the G4 lane gates (M7-0); OD-24 option E keeps this rule with a `ZkStdLib`-architecture wrap over `L_Fr` (LW-017).

CPR-005.sentence: No requirement, constant or gate of the co-processor SHALL narrow GP-001 to GP-004 or GP-ZK. A design constant that could narrow them SHALL be an owner decision with a path that has no bound.

GPW-007.sentence: A wrap time figure SHALL be reported MEASURED only with its run record and host load. Heavy jobs SHALL run one at a time under `heavy-run`. A quiet-host repeat SHALL stay PENDING until measured. The wrap times of call-time paths 2 and 3 SHALL be reported as ESTIMATE conditional on the fused quotient kernel and the MSM rewrite, with the table of `PR` section 8 (k = 19 proxy, 20 and 21, MEASURED under load) as the baseline.

HDM-001.sentence: Every Fr-side Sherlock hash SHALL use the Midnight Poseidon permutation, width 3, rate 2. The initial capacity SHALL be `cap(u, l) = l + u 2^66` for a fixed length `l` and `2^64 + u 2^66` for the transcript. The use codes SHALL be 0 program operations; 1, 2, 3 the Merkle leaf, Merkle node and transcript of `L`; 4 public digests; 5, 6, 7 the Merkle leaf, Merkle node and transcript of `L_Fr` (OD-18); 8 the lock operand sponge `x_j` of ANC-002.

HDM-002.sentence: A public digest SHALL be `PoseidonFr(tag, pack(d2))` with `u` = 4. The tags SHALL be `SHK_PROGC` for `C_P`, `SHK_LOCK` for the lock values `A_j`, `SHK_INPUT` for `input_d` and `SHK_OUTCOME` for `outcome_d` (OD-18). The Fr value of each tag SHALL be published with a differential vector before the hash domains freeze (ENC-1); until then the tag rows are FREEZE-PENDING.

HDM-003.sentence: The Merkle leaf and node hashes of `L` (`u` = 1 and 2) SHALL use Midnight's fixed-length sponge in place of the stock leaf hasher and the truncated-permutation compression. A Merkle leaf SHALL pack 8 BabyBear words per Fr element, with checked length and words below `2^31`.

HDM-004.sentence: The transcript of `L` SHALL be the stark-backend multi-field overwrite duplex over Fr with Midnight's permutation, stock in every transition, with one change: the initial capacity cell `s_2 = 2^64 + 3 * 2^66` (OD-18). The verifier of `L` inside `L_Fr` SHALL implement the duplex natively in the trace of `L_Fr`. The transcript of `L_Fr` SHALL be the same duplex with the initial capacity `2^64 + 7 * 2^66`, and the wrap SHALL implement it with the stdlib Poseidon chip.

HDM-005.sentence: The key schedule `sched` SHALL fix the count of words between any two flushes. The verifier of `L` inside `L_Fr` SHALL follow `sched`. It SHALL NOT follow the proof (LW-002).

HDM-006.sentence: Each non-final round of `L` SHALL take one OOD sample in the stock order of WHIR Construction 5.1: observe the round commitment, sample one OOD point, observe its answer, then the query PoW, the query indices and `gamma` as stock, with the answer batched with the query answers under one `gamma` (`q_i + 1` claims) (OD-19).

HDM-007.sentence: Every Sherlock-defined Poseidon2 hash over BabyBear SHALL absorb its tag word first, with the total length in the first capacity word. The tags SHALL be `TAG_EMPTY`, `tagStep`, `tagEnt`, `TAG_NODE`, `DOM_PROG`, `DOM_PROGC`, `DOM_LOCK`, `DOM_KEYTRIPLE`, `DOM_KEYDAG`, `DOM_KEYNODE` and `DOM_LAYOUT`. Each new digest SHALL take a new tag. The leaf, leaf-layer and internal layers SHALL keep the stock OpenVM hashes and challenger (premise A4).

HDM-008.sentence: Each squeeze SHALL give 5 base-`p` digits with bias at most `2^-100`. The recomposition of the digits SHALL be checked below `r`.

HDM-009.sentence: The nine transcript vectors T-FS of `FD/EXPERIMENTS.md` section 2 SHALL give the same digits and the same final state on the CPU prover, the GPU prover, the stark-backend verifier and the `L_Fr` tape, and the same holds for the `L_Fr` transcript on its prover, its verifier and the wrap's verifier of `L_Fr`. Until they pass, the transcript SHALL be reported PENDING.

HDM-010.sentence: The hash domains and the transcript SHALL be reported proved only when BR-L2 names the two Fr sponge algorithms on the one permutation and follows the one-sample order of HDM-006. Premises A2b (`frSpongeInj`) and A5 (`p2Inj`) SHALL stay named hypotheses.

LW-001.sentence: `L` SHALL verify the node root proof on the full tree or the leaf-layer proof on path C. `L` SHALL take the flattened field log and its tree shape as private witness. `L` SHALL expose the statement words, the anchor statement `(mode, j, k, a_in, a_out)`, `run_tag` for a chunk, `layout_d`, `pv` of `W_pv` words, the DAG commitment `X` and the call vector of `2 + L_TX` words as public values.

LW-002.sentence: `L_Fr` SHALL verify the proof of `L` under the frozen `L` key (OD-24 option E). The verifier of `L` inside `L_Fr` SHALL follow the key schedule `sched`, the transcript algorithm of HDM-004 and the one-sample WHIR order of HDM-006 (OD-18, OD-19). It SHALL NOT follow the structure of the proof. The wrap SHALL verify the proof of `L_Fr` natively in Fr under the frozen `L_Fr` key and the `L_Fr` transcript (u = 7, HDM-001).

LW-003.sentence: The wrap SHALL have exactly the call vector of `2 + L_TX` words as public inputs, with `L_TX` = 1,024 (OD-7, OD-15). Lane 0 SHALL be `binding_input`. Lane 1 SHALL be `comm`. Unused lanes SHALL be constrained zero.

LW-004.sentence: The wrap SHALL check range and `Canon` on every logged value, a bounded quotient on every lazy reduction and a canonical recomposition on every squeeze. It SHALL absorb `pv` natively and bind it by one `eq` evaluation. It SHALL replay every entry natively. It SHALL check the offset sums and the padding rules. It SHALL require every entry of the reservation `R` (FLG-004, FLG-006).

LW-005.sentence: The wrap SHALL require the `popeq` lane to equal `a_in`. `a_in` and `a_out` SHALL be outputs of `DIGEST` entries of the log. The `a_in` tag SHALL be `SHK_PROGC` when `mode` is ORD or `j = 1`, else `SHK_LOCK`. The `a_out` tag SHALL be `SHK_PROGC` when `mode` is ORD or `j = k`, else `SHK_LOCK`. Lane 0 SHALL equal `bind`. `layout_d` SHALL equal the key constant (OD-5, OD-16).

LW-006.sentence: The wrap SHALL check `Canon` on the limbs of `X`. The wrap SHALL require `X` to equal the cached-trace commitment of `L` that it reads.

LW-007.sentence: A general run SHALL be a Sherlock program whose effect words write its run statement `[C_P, input_pub, outcome_pub]` (OD-15), with the public digest forms of FPR-010. The statement SHALL refuse Running. `n_steps` SHALL NOT be public (FPR-013). No state digest, memory root, tail digest, length, address, plain `prog_d` or `result_be` SHALL be public (LW-003, ZK-002). The public program identity `C_P` is LEAD F-7 under owner item N-11.

LW-008.sentence: The run statement SHALL come from a SET root sealed by NODE INTEGRATION. The opening layer SHALL recompute `claim_d`. It SHALL open the root with one hash as `LEAF(claim_d, n_steps)` or `DEP(claim_d, n_steps, cover_root, in_link)`. It SHALL refuse a SEG, `JOIN`, `FOREIGN`, `ADM` or `VIEW` root. It SHALL check no seal predicate. The opening layer SHALL be `L` (FPR-007, LEAD F-6).

LW-009.sentence: A collection SHALL publish `[reg_root, set_root]` through its effect words, with a schema separate from the run statement. `shape_d` SHALL NOT be public (owner ruling O9, 2026-11-13). No claim count SHALL be public, range-checked or used for soundness (AD-2, OWNER). The entry label SHALL discriminate the collection statement from the run statement (FPR-008). The contract entry SHALL be `acceptCollection(reg_pub, set_pub)`.

LW-010.sentence: The replay identity SHALL be `claim_d = P2(SHK_RUN, 1, prog_d, input_d, outcome_d)`, without `n_steps` and without any physical field (SRC-007, SRC-023). The contract SHALL key it by its public image `claim_pub = transientHash([C_P, input_pub, outcome_pub])` (FPR-010). Every partition of one run SHALL have the salt of its `input_d`, so every partition SHALL have one `claim_pub`.

LW-011.sentence: If AD-20 selects option (b), the run statement SHALL either refuse a `DEP` head whose cover holds a FOREIGN member, or check `reg_root` read from contract state. The three run values SHALL NOT change. Under option (a) this requirement SHALL have no effect.

LW-012.sentence: Every wrap proof SHALL use fresh CSPRNG blinders. A seeded wrap proof SHALL exist only in a test mode (ZK-003).

LW-013.sentence: The wrap SHALL be one `ZkStdLib`-architecture circuit (OD-24 option E) that ledger 9.1.0.1 reads with `MidnightVK::read`, at k at most 21. It SHALL verify `L_Fr` with the stdlib chips (Poseidon over Fr, range checks, Fr Merkle paths, the sumcheck and WHIR verifier, the Fr transcript replay). It SHALL have no foreign-field, pairing or SHA chip, and no G4 lane gate (LW-017).

LW-014.sentence: Wrap keygen SHALL refuse a log capacity that does not hold the largest reservation `R`, and an `L` or `L_Fr` key whose query vector or shape bounds differ from the frozen set. The Fr-native layer between `L` and the wrap SHALL be `L_Fr` of OD-24 option E. No second Fr proving engine SHALL be built as a call-time fallback (OD-11, owner decision 2026-11-12); `L_Fr` is part of the one proving path.

LW-015.sentence: The kit SHALL be reported complete only when BR-L2, BR-L4 and DEC-L1 are proved with axiom reports that hold only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`. Premises A1 to A7, A2' (`lfrSound`) and the static checks `vkL_ok` and `vkLFr_ok` SHALL stay named hypotheses or kernel-checked conditions.

LW-016.sentence: The wrap SHALL be qualified on OD-24 option E (step E5), as the stdlib wrap of `L_Fr` over the complete `L` interface (12,166 public words at 5 lane-map pairs (O7), log AIRs, root and anchor statements, DAG key check), with `R` as real non-`NOP` entries, on the full tree and on path C at the worst admitted shapes. Rows and k SHALL come from keygen, and the serialized ledger key SHALL be measured against 50,000 bytes. A benchmark on `L_cached` with an all-`NOP` log SHALL qualify no gate (FZ-3).

LW-017.sentence: The wrap key SHALL be one that ledger 9.1.0.1 reads unchanged: a `ZkStdLib`-architecture key (OD-24 option E). No G4 figure SHALL be reported as ledger-accepted. Ledger 9 refuses a key with G4 lane gates (M7-0, MEASURED on a toy key).

LW-018.sentence: `L_Fr` SHALL be a STARK on stark-backend over BLS12-381 Fr with no extension field. It SHALL take the proof of `L` as private witness, emulate the BabyBear and `EF` arithmetic of its verifier with a bounded quotient on every reduction, and hash the Merkle paths and transcript of `L` natively. Its own hashes SHALL use u = 5, 6, 7 (HDM-001). Its public values SHALL be the `L` key pre-hash, then the public values of `L` packed 8 per Fr word. Its key SHALL pin the `L` key and heights (LW-019).

LW-019.sentence: The `L_Fr` key SHALL use unique decoding at log blowup 3, `l_skip` 2, `n_stack` 18, `w_stack` at most 48, `k_whir` 4, queries 98/83/82 and query PoW 20, with one OOD sample per round, every term at 100 bits or more and every grindable term at 101 bits or more (SQG-004).

PRD-001.sentence: The Sherlock prover SHALL be a resident daemon that listens on a local socket (OD-13). It SHALL serve only a peer of the same user on the same machine.

PRD-002.sentence: The daemon SHALL hold a pool of one-use blinding slots with fresh CSPRNG blinders. Each slot SHALL be consumed by exactly one `wrap_prove`. A slot SHALL NOT be serialized off the machine. A slot made by a helper SHALL be refused.

PRD-003.sentence: No STARK proof, prover checkpoint or shard plan of a private program SHALL leave the daemon's trust domain. The trust domain SHALL be the user's own devices and GPUs (OD-9).

PRD-004.sentence: The daemon and its slot pool SHALL be built with path C in build step 15. A one-leaf Compact call SHALL take path C: one leaf, one leaf layer at internal parameters, no internal node, then `L` and the wrap.

PRD-005.sentence: The design lists no Lean obligation for the prover daemon. Its zero-knowledge role SHALL rest on ZK-L1 and premise A7 of kit ZERO KNOWLEDGE (ZK-010).

SQG-001.sentence: Every layer on the chain of a call SHALL have at least 100 bits of round-by-round soundness proven from theorems as stated, with no unproved conjecture. The layers SHALL be the leaf, the OpenVM leaf layer, the internal layers, `L`, `L_Fr` and the wrap. Every STARK layer SHALL run WHIR in unique decoding (OD-19 for the internal and `L` layers). The design SHALL claim this security only after gate checks G1 to G4 pass with G5. Until then every bit count SHALL be reported as a calculator figure.

SQG-002.sentence: Each layer SHALL have one parameter set and one set of shape bounds, as `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.9 lists them (app and leaf sets OD-4; internal and `L` sets OD-19; `L_Fr` OD-24). Every layer SHALL have the shape bound that the total interaction count of one proof is below `p`. The sets SHALL freeze with the universal keys. Keygen SHALL refuse a key outside the bounds of its layer and a key whose per-round query vector differs from the frozen one.

SQG-003.sentence: `L` SHALL use BabyBear with `EF` of degree 4, Midnight Poseidon over Fr for its Merkle tree and transcript, 8 BabyBear elements per Fr element, WHIR with `k_whir` = 4, 3 rounds, a final polynomial of `2^8` and `WhirProximityStrategy::UniqueDecoding` in every round. It SHALL use log blowup 3, queries 98/83/82, folding PoW 0, `mu` PoW 6, query PoW 20, LogUp PoW 18 and one OOD sample per round in the stock WHIR order (OD-19).

SQG-004.sentence: Every term of every layer SHALL be at least 100 bits. Every grindable term (folding, `mu`, query, LogUp) SHALL be at least 101 bits through its PoW constant. The app, leaf-aggregation and internal sets SHALL use query PoW 21 (OD-4, OD-19). The leaf-aggregation set SHALL use LogUp PoW 17.

SQG-005.sentence: The `L` key SHALL have the shape bound `w_stack` at most 48 with `mu` PoW 6 (OD-19; frozen by owner decision 2026-11-12). D10 measured `w_stack` 18 on `L_cached` and 26 without the cache (branch `d10-heights`, commit `3b979bd5c`). The internal set SHALL keep its own bound 512.

SQG-006.sentence: G1 SHALL pass only when the sets of OD-4, OD-17, OD-18 (owner decisions 2026-11-12), the internal and `L` sets of OD-19 and the `L_Fr` set of OD-24 option E are fixed in the key-generation code with the explicit per-round query vectors, the global interaction bound, query PoW 21 for the app, leaf-aggregation and internal sets and LogUp PoW 17 for the leaf-aggregation set.

SQG-007.sentence: G2 SHALL pass only when the stock calculator, after build step 4, prints every term of every layer at its shape bounds at 100 bits or more, and every grindable term at 101 or more, on the frozen query vectors, with `L` at the `w_stack` that D10 measures.

SQG-008.sentence: G3 SHALL pass only when the prover, the stark-backend verifier, the calculator and the verifier of `L` inside `L_Fr` follow the stock one-sample WHIR order of HDM-006 and the transcript of HDM-004 and HDM-005, the T-FS vectors are equal on all four implementations, and the same holds for the `L_Fr` transcript (u = 7) and the wrap's verifier of `L_Fr`.

SQG-009.sentence: G4 SHALL pass only when the restated theorem is committed with a build log of 0 sorry and the standard axioms only, the concrete `L` key passes `ProvenRegime` by `decide`, and the `L_Fr` set passes a parameter gate under premise A2'.

SQG-010.sentence: G5 SHALL pass only when a written mapping shows that each hypothesis of WHIR Theorem 5.2 holds for each frozen set in unique decoding, by WHIR Lemma 4.10, Corollary 4.11, the unique decoding branch of Theorem 4.8 and Lemma 4.25, and the unique decoding branch of SWIRL Theorem 4.2.4, with one OOD sample and the `gamma` batching of `q_i + 1` claims.

SQG-011.sentence: No universal key SHALL freeze before G1 to G4 pass with G5 and FP-8 closes (FPR-019). The frozen items of SPL-009 SHALL freeze only after the gate passes.

SQG-012.sentence: The gate SHALL count Lean as passed only when BR-L2 is proved, with `ProvenRegime` in the unique decoding regime, the frozen per-round query vector, the PoW constants, one OOD sample per round and the `w_stack` bound. Premises A2 (`lastLayerSound`) and A2' (`lfrSound`) SHALL stay named hypotheses.

SQG-013.sentence: The MERGE-WORK nodes SHALL have their own set `merge_work`. It SHALL have the internal parameters and query vector 97/82/81, and the internal bounds with 5,400 columns (owner ruling N-6 "own bounds", 2026-11-14).

SPL-001.sentence: The co-processor SHALL prove a run in the layers of `FD/ARCHITECTURE.md` section 1.6: the per-program plan, leaf shards, nodes, `L`, the wrap and the ledger check. Leaves, nodes and `L` SHALL be STARKs over BabyBear with `EF = BabyBear^4`. The wrap SHALL be midnight-proofs PLONK with KZG over BLS12-381 and the only layer that hides.

SPL-002.sentence: `sherlock plan` SHALL run once per program with no witness. It SHALL output the static plan: the instruction tables, the shape menu, the scheduling policy, the log layout rule with `R` first, the placement rule of discharge shards and of tier E and GP-3 chips, and the per-program keys under `key_root`. It SHALL NOT output the cut points, tree or shard count of a general run (SPL-011, FZ-5).

SPL-003.sentence: `prog_d` SHALL be `H2(DOM_PROG, image_d, plan_d, key_root, machine_version)` under `sherlock-value/2`. `plan_d` SHALL follow SPL-012. A public program SHALL publish `(prog_d, r_P)` in its manifest. A private program SHALL keep both secret.

SPL-004.sentence: Per program, the app key, the OpenVM leaf-layer key and the internal-for-leaf key of each chip set SHALL be committed under `key_root`, with the Fr commitment `X` of the child DAG per entry and tree path. The internal-recursive key, the `L` key and the wrap key SHALL be the same for every program. The wrap key, the `L` key and the log capacity SHALL NOT depend on the plan.

SPL-005.sentence: On the full tree the first universal node SHALL check each child key commitment by a Poseidon2 inclusion path into `key_root`. It SHALL forward the root.
