On path C, `L` SHALL prove the inclusion of `P2(DOM_KEYDAG, entry, path, enc(X))` with `X` public in `L`. The wrap SHALL check `X` (LW-006).

SPL-006.sentence: Every leaf and node SHALL have a fixed shape from the plan menu. Nodes SHALL have a fixed arity. Work SHALL grow by adding shards. No key constant SHALL bound the run length or the Fr work (CPR-002).

SPL-007.sentence: Leaves, nodes and `L` SHALL be proved by OpenVM stark-backend v2.1.0 with its CUDA prover (owner, 2026-11-11). Plonky3 0.9.0-rc.2 with Plonky3-recursion SHALL be the second choice. Production SHALL set `zerocheck_save_memory = false` per AIR set. A program key SHALL list only the AIRs that its leaves use.

SPL-008.sentence: The `R_SL_*` family and its chips SHALL define the machine version `sherlock-k-a/2`. `prog_d` SHALL bind `machine_version`. New rules and chips SHALL change only per-program keys.

SPL-009.sentence: The log operation list, the capacity with the encoding of `pv` (OD-6, OD-17), the limb encoding, `L_TX` and the public-table layout (OD-7, OD-15), the anchor template words and the anchor statement (OD-16), the hash domains (OD-18), the per-layer parameter sets and shape bounds (OD-4, OD-19), the public value `X` and the constant fields of the internal layer SHALL freeze with the universal keys, and only after the security gate passes (SQG-011) and FP-8 closes (FPR-019).

SPL-010.sentence: The plan binding SHALL be reported proved only when BR-L2 adds the DAG key check to `wrap_refines`. Premise A4 (`recSound`) SHALL stay a named hypothesis.

SPL-011.sentence: The prover SHALL make the per-run schedule (cuts, tree, shape, device, concurrency, suspensions) from a metered run and the setup-mode profile `sherlock-profile/1`. `key_root` SHALL hold no schedule menu or shard-count list. The setup mode SHALL NOT select a key, a shape or `plan_d`. The schedule SHALL stay on the user's machine. Each leaf shape SHALL be checked against `key_root`, and every schedule of one run SHALL give one `claim_pub` (FZ-5, SC-010 to SC-013).

SPL-012.sentence: `plan_d` SHALL be `P2(DOM_PLAN, 1: u16, itab_d, menu_d, policy_d, layout_rule_d, place_d)`, each digest the `P2` hash of the canonical word list of one part of the static plan, in that order. `plan_d` SHALL NOT bind a per-run schedule. The word lists and the code of `DOM_PLAN` are FREEZE-PENDING ENC-5.

ZK-001.sentence: Leaves, nodes, `L`, `L_Fr` and the wrap prover SHALL run on the user's machine. Hosts that the user owns SHALL count as the user's machine (OD-9, case A). A host that the user does not own is a helper (case B) and SHALL be refused (ZK-018). No PCS masking SHALL be added while every STARK layer stays in case A. STARK proofs, prover checkpoints and the shard plan of a private program SHALL be treated as secrets like the witness.

ZK-002.sentence: The published view of a call SHALL be the call vector and one blinded wrap proof. The used log count, the deferred-or-emulated split, the shard plan, the AIR set and heights, and plain `prog_d` SHALL NOT be in that view.

ZK-003.sentence: Every wrap proof SHALL take fresh CSPRNG blinders. `r_P` SHALL be drawn once per deployment, the input salt once per run, and the wrap blinders once per proof (ZK-012, ZK-013). A seeded blinder SHALL be accepted only by a build with the cargo feature `test-seed` (ZK-014). Byte-identity tests of the GPU wrap SHALL use the test-only seed patch under `GW_DET=1` in a `test-seed` build.

ZK-004.sentence: No value derived from the transcript of `L` or of `L_Fr` SHALL become a public input or a constant of the wrap. `X`, `mode`, `j`, `k` and `run_tag` SHALL be public values of `L` only, carried packed in the public values of `L_Fr`. The wrap SHALL take them as private witness.

ZK-005.sentence: The log SHALL be padded with `NOP` to its fixed capacity. The call vector SHALL be padded with constrained zeros to `L_TX` (OD-7, OD-15). The count of used entries and the deferred-or-emulated split SHALL NOT be readable from the call vector.

ZK-006.sentence: The run salt SHALL be 8 BabyBear words from the user's CSPRNG, placed first in the preimage of `input_d = P2(SHK_IN, salt, val_d, fuel_lo, fuel_hi, stack_limit)` and fixed for the run at INIT. The salt SHALL NOT be published in public values, the call vector, a log entry or any other form, except inside the digests of ZK-011. `outcome_d` SHALL carry no salt of its own. The public digests SHALL follow ZK-011.

ZK-007.sentence: The anchor lane SHALL carry `C_P` or a lock value `A_j`. Plain `prog_d` SHALL NOT reach the ledger through the anchor (ANC-001).

ZK-008.sentence: Per-AIR heights and the set of AIRs present SHALL stay inside the user's trust boundary. `n_steps` SHALL NOT be public (FPR-013, LEAD F-12 under the owner's `n_steps` rule): the exact height `n_steps = h_hi` that SEAL forwards (NODE-003) SHALL stay private inside the SET forms. Leaf counts SHALL stay on the user's machine with the rest of the schedule (SPL-011). Where a secret branch changes the transcript length of a chunked call, filler chunks SHALL pad the chunk count to the entry bound.

ZK-009.sentence: The design SHALL NOT allow a helper (case B of ZK-001) that proves a STARK layer or `L`, a remote unmasked MSM, NTT, quotient or Merkle hash, the full sponge state on a helper, reuse of a blinding slot, or a helper-made slot. No aggregator SHALL receive STARK proofs. One wrap SHALL settle one `ContractCall`. A user batch SHALL be opt-in with one batch digest per `acceptRun` (OD-12).

ZK-010.sentence: The kit SHALL be reported complete only when ZK-L1 and ZK-L2 are proved with axiom reports that hold only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`. Premise A7 (`wrapZK`) SHALL stay a named hypothesis.

ZK-011.sentence: The public digests SHALL be `C_P = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_PROGC, pack(P2(DOM_PROGC, r_P, prog_d)))` with `r_P` 8 words per deployment, `input_pub = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_INPUT, pack(input_d))` and `outcome_pub = PoseidonFr_4(SHK_OUTCOME, pack(P2(DOM_OUTHIDE, input_d, outcome_d)))`, so the outcome is hidden under the salt inside `input_d` (FP-4, FPR-010). The shard plan SHALL bind to the unsalted `prog_d` inside the STARK layers only. ZK-001 and LW-012 keep proofs local and blinders fresh.

GP-001.sentence: One fixed key set SHALL prove the execution of every program of the Sherlock language, on every input, for every run length below 2^64 and every outcome (`Halted(v)` for every value type as a digest of a canonical value encoding, `Rejected(code)`, `Exhausted(kind)`). The public statement SHALL carry `prog_d` and `input_d` as data, not circuit constants. Capacity SHALL NOT depend on the key: a program whose state does not fit one leaf's carriers runs against committed memory.

GP-002.sentence: A proven run SHALL be consumable by another proof, with the consumed claim `(prog_d', input_d', outcome_d')` checked in-circuit, not trusted; independent runs of the same or different programs SHALL aggregate into one proof whose statement commits to the set of claims. (Added 2026-11-10 by the C6 outcome-only review, `research/sherlock-c6-outcome-ledger9-review-20261110/review.md:168`.

GP-003.sentence: The recursion SHALL verify and aggregate proofs of circuits other than the Sherlock leaf (Compact contract circuits and other PLONK/halo2 circuits on the same curve and commitment scheme). A circuit SHALL be admitted by a verifying key whose identity is a member of an authenticated registry, with membership proved in-circuit, and a statement adapter SHALL map its public inputs to the common claim form.

GP-004.sentence: Aggregation SHALL cover chains, trees and DAGs of any depth with one key set (node arity at least 2 plus new work; no per-depth or per-level key); the shape SHALL be bound into the statement; the final proof size and verification cost SHALL NOT grow with depth or the number of claims. (Added 2026-11-10 by the C6 outcome-only review, `research/sherlock-c6-outcome-ledger9-review-20261110/review.md:172`.
